component.name: Noctorium
component.summary: One music player for YouTube Music and SoundCloud

description.p: Noctorium plays YouTube Music and SoundCloud from one place: one library, one queue, scrobbling, lyrics, and Connect to the Noctorium phone app.
This Flatpak carries its own mpv, so it plays without anything else installed.
Noctorium is an independent third-party client. It is not affiliated with Google, YouTube or SoundCloud.
